opponents.name: Painter Jericho
opponents.meet_text: The evening sun is the most perfect time to come here and paint... or play cards!
opponents.repeat_text: I've been painting a lot of great pieces from this spot.
opponents.first_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.rematch_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.loss_text: To win is a beautiful piece of art.

opponents.name: Gardener Callum
opponents.meet_text: Wowee, it was a long day gardening today. I'm down for a match to let off some steam now.
opponents.repeat_text: I've got time for a rematch before my next shift.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm clearly too worn out from such a long shift.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll win when I'm fully rested.
opponents.loss_text: Even after a hard days work I can still win!

opponents.name: Psychic Brienne
opponents.meet_text: I love the peace of the harbour at night, the sound of the waves in the dark are really relaxing.
opponents.repeat_text: It's easier to meditate at night.
opponents.first_win_text: I have to focus more. Take these cards to help you focus more too.

opponents.name: Bad Dude Paul
opponents.meet_text: Heh you want to try and beat me kid??
opponents.repeat_text: Damn... they're gonna kick me out of the cool guy biker gang for this.
opponents.first_win_text: Heh you're pretty tough, you wanna join our gang?
opponents.rematch_win_text: Now they're DEFINITELY going to kick me out of the cool guy biker gang...

opponents.name: Birdspotter Gregg
opponents.meet_text: My friend said this is a great spot to find them but also a great spot to battle.
opponents.repeat_text: This really is a great spot for birds and cards!
opponents.first_win_text: Do you hate birds or something?.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Well at least I can watch the birds from around here.
opponents.loss_text: Looking after birds really isn't easy!

opponents.name: Bad Dude Wayne
opponents.meet_text: I caught these bad looking dudes heading to the forest and they gave me some interesting cards and went on their way.
opponents.first_win_text: You even seen a Dark Pokemon before?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I need some more of these Dark cards.

opponents.name: Battlegirl Sofia
opponents.meet_text: This beach is a great spot to train both my martial arts and my card skills.
opponents.repeat_text: Want to join in with my training?
opponents.first_win_text: A loss is always a good chance to improve.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm going to keep on training.
opponents.loss_text: I rarely lose when I've trained properly.
